fix(docs): a program's global console writes to its terminal (rich-playground-afk.6dm) (#240)

* fix(docs): a program's global console writes to its terminal (rich-playground-afk.6dm)

runInTerminal binds `console` lexically, as it binds `process`, to Node's
console on the stand-in's streams, formatted by Node's own util.format
(node-inspect-extracted). The body is wrapped in a block so a program's own
`const console = new Console()` shadows the parameter rather than
redeclaring it.

Found by the playground checkpoint (rich-playground-afk.oui): a bare
console.log in the playground went to devtools and the terminal stayed empty.

* fix(docs): the program's console colours by Node's env rules (rich-playground-afk.6dm)

Review (high): colour came from isTTY alone, so NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR and
TERM=dumb were ignored; each table row is what Node 26 printed on a pty and
a pipe. The module header now names the console parameter, the formatter's
weight is recorded where it was chosen, and the host-leak check spies on all
five methods and restores them in afterEach.
